attempting-to-pickpocket-before-haunted-.text: I doubt he's got much of value on him.

options.text: I've done it, I've managed to recreate the salve amulet!

steps.player: I've done it, I've managed to recreate the salve amulet that you spoke of.

steps.text: If the player has not given the zealot his key back:

steps.npc: That hardly seems likely. There is no way you could have made it to the bottom of the mines without the key which is in my possession.

steps.player: I, er... found another way down.

steps.npc: Mock me not, this is a serious task I am undertaking. I don't have the time for your halfwitted attempt at humour.

options.text: Correction, the key that was in your possession.

steps.player: Correction, the key that was in your possession.

steps.npc: My key, where is it? You stole it?
Return that key to me now!

options.text: Ok, I've finished with it now anyway.

steps.player: Ok, I've finished with it now anyway.

steps.npc: Good, maybe all is not lost, despite your apparent lack of common sense.

options.text: Actually maybe I'll just keep hold of it for now.

steps.player: Actually, maybe I'll just keep hold of it for now.

steps.npc: Meddling fool, there are bigger things at stake here than you and your petty thieving intellect can understand.

steps.text: If the player has given the zealot his key back:

steps.npc: Then it is fortunate for us that Saradomin has guided you. Success certainly doesn't seem likely to have stemmed from rational behaviour on your part.

steps.player: You still haven't forgiven me for borrowing your key have you?
Er, maybe I'd better be going now.

options.text: What powers does the salve amulet have?

steps.player: What powers does the salve amulet have?

steps.npc: From what I have heard they would be put to best use in the slaying of the evil undead, the zombies and skeletons that walk this land.

after-haunted-mine-attempting-to-pickpoc.text: I don't want to annoy him any further.
